Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text:
I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!
I'm the awesome dude who makes deep-sea dives to gather treasures resting at the bottom.
Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of tools made in ancient times?

You haven't got any treasures for me…
If you see any SHARDS, like the RED SHARD, you've got to trade it with me!

Oh, hey! That… That's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!
Oh, man, you've got to trade that with me! I'll give you something good!
What do you want to trade?
You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}, then?
It's a done deal! Use that wisely!
Do you want to trade something else?
Whoops, your BAG's full. Get rid of some items, friend!
No? That's a downer. Well, if you change your mind, come back.
